title: Lifecycle Event
description: Single user-driven lifecycle transition record per ARCHITECTURE.md §6 + Wave 4 Step C state machine. One event is appended to state.lifecycle.events on every PATCH /api/runs/{run_id}/lifecycle call.

state.description: Target state of the transition (the state the run entered when this event fired).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the transition occurred.

note.description: Optional free-text note from the user (e.g. 'OA on Codility, 60min').

channel.description: Optional submission channel identifier (e.g. 'linkedin', 'company_portal', 'email', 'referral'). Mostly used on the tailored→applied transition.
